'''Anna Jaśkiewicz''' is a Polish mathematician and a professor of mathematics at [[Wrocław University of Science and Technology]]. Her research focuses on [[stochastic game]]s, Markov control processes, [[dynamic programming]], and risk-sensitive optimization, with applications to [[Economic dynamism|economic dynamics]] and [[operations research]].<ref name="NNPolska">{{cite web |title=prof. dr hab. inż. Anna Jaśkiewicz |url=https://ludzie.nauka.gov.pl/ln/profiles/anna.ja%C5%9Bkiewicz.R5BvnFNfn2d |access-date=19 January 2026 |website=Nowa Nauka Polska |publisher=National Information Processing Institute |language=pl-PL}}</ref><ref name="NPolska">{{cite web |date=2016 |title=prof. dr hab. Anna Jaśkiewicz |url=https://archiwum.nauka-polska.pl/#/profile/scientist?id=117571&_k=sq0sus |access-date=19 January 2026 |website=Nauka Polska |publisher=National Information Processing Institute |language=pl-PL}}</ref>

== Education and career ==
Jaśkiewicz was a student at the [[:pl:Wydział Podstawowych Problemów Techniki|Faculty of Fundamental Problems of Technology]], [[Wrocław University of Science and Technology]], where she earned a master's degree in mathematics in 2000. In 2003, at the [[:pl:Instytut Matematyki i Informatyki Politechniki Wrocławskiej|Institute of Mathematics and Computer Science, Wrocław University of Technology]] she defended her PhD thesis in mathematics on semi-Markov decision processes and stochastic games with the distinction. Her PhD advisor was [[Andrzej Nowak (mathematician)|Andrzej S. Nowak]].<ref name="PhDPWr_AJ">{{Cite thesis |author=Anna Jaśkiewicz |title=On zero sum stochastic games with general state space |access-date=2024-10-16 |degree=PhD |publisher=Wrocław University of Technology |url=https://dona.pwr.edu.pl/szukaj/default.aspx?nrsys=134478 |year=2003}}</ref><ref name="MGP_ASN">{{cite web |title=Anna Jaśkiewicz – The Mathematics Genealogy Project |url=https://www.genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu/id.php?id=150130 |access-date=2025-10-14 |website=www.genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu}}</ref> She completed her habilitation in mathematics in 2010 and was awarded the title of professor by the [[President of Poland]] in 2021.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Nominacja profesorska prof. Anny Jaśkiewicz |url=https://wmat.pwr.edu.pl/o-wydziale/aktualnosci/nominacja-profesorska-prof-anny-jaskiewicz-11107.html |access-date=2025-12-04 |website=wmat.pwr.edu.pl |language=pl}}</ref> She has been affiliated with Wrocław University of Science and Technology throughout her academic career, where she currently holds a professorship in the [[:pl:Wydział Matematyki Politechniki Wrocławskiej|Faculty of Pure and Applied Mathematics]]. 

== Research ==
Her work addresses stochastic dynamic [[decision model]]s, including [[Markov decision process]]es, stochastic games, [[recursive method]]s in economic dynamics, risk-sensitive criteria, and issues of [[time inconsistency]] in control models .<ref name="MathSciNet">{{cite web |author=Anna Jaśkiewicz |year=2000 |title=List of publications in MathSciNet |url=https://mathscinet.ams.org/mathscinet/MRAuthorID/671269 |access-date=2024-02-19 |publisher=American Mathematical Society |language=en}}</ref><ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Anna Jaśkiewicz - Author Profile - zbMATH Open |url=https://zbmath.org/authors/jaskiewicz.anna |access-date=2026-01-23 |website=zbmath.org}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Anna Jaśkiewicz |url=https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=tlxQqnAAAAAJ&hl=pl&oi=ao |access-date=2026-01-24 |website=scholar.google.com}}</ref>

=== Selected Publications ===
Her publications include articles in ''[[SIAM Journal on Control and Optimization]]'', ''Automatica'', ''[[Journal of Economic Theory]]'', ''[[Mathematics of Operations Research]]'', ''Finance and Stochastics'', and ''Dynamic Games and Applications''.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |author=Anna Jaśkiewicz |title=ORCID |url=https://orcid.org/0000-0002-8480-7850 |access-date=2025-01-22 |website=orcid.org}}</ref><ref name="MathSciNet" /><ref name=":0" />

Anna Jaśkiewicz obtained her most important research results in stochastic games and dynamic decision models with standard and risk sensitivity payoff criteria. Her interests focus on time inconsistency, the existence of [[Nash equilibria]], in particular Markov perfect equilibria.<ref name=":1" />

== Service and recognition ==
Jaśkiewicz has served as an associate editor of ''Dynamic Games and Applications'',<ref>{{Cite web |first= |title=Dynamic Games and Applications. Associate Editors |url=https://link.springer.com/journal/13235/editorial-board |access-date=2026-01-23 |website=SpringerLink |language=en}}</ref> ''[[Operations Research Letters]]'',<ref>{{Cite journal |date=2023 |title=Editorial Board |url=https://linkinghub.elsevier.com/retrieve/pii/S0167637719304729 |journal=Operations Research Letters |language=en |volume=47 |issue=5 |pages=IFC |doi=10.1016/S0167-6377(19)30472-9 |quote=Anna Jaśkiewicz (Associate Editors)|last=|first=|url-access=subscription }}</ref> and ''SIAM Journal on Control and Optimization''.<ref name="EdSIAM">{{Cite web |title=SIAM Journal on Control and Optimization – Editorial Board |url-status=live |url=https://epubs.siam.org/pb-assets/migrated/SICON2023.pdf |access-date=2026-01-23|date=2025-01-23 |website=SIAM Journal on Control and Optimization |language=en}}</ref> She has been a member of the Executive Board of the International Society of Dynamic Games and has acted as a reviewer for doctoral and habilitation theses in Poland and abroad. She is a recipient of research fellowships from the [[Alexander von Humboldt Foundation]]<ref>{{Cite web |title=Dr. Anna Jaskiewicz |url=https://www.humboldt-foundation.de/en/connect/explore-the-humboldt-network/singleview/1119851/dr-anna-jaskiewicz |access-date=2026-01-23 |website=www.humboldt-foundation.de |language=en}}</ref> and has received multiple Rector's Awards from Wrocław University of Science and Technology for scientific achievements.{{cn|date=February 2026}}
